text: Harness: record actual tokens, money and time per idea as its realized cost
description: Every stage reports provider usage (tokens in/out, $ from a per-model price table, wall time). Sum per idea and per cycle; store on the idea as actual cost next to the estimate. Enforce a per-cycle and per-day budget in the harness. This is exactly the data the priority-model calibration (b2a7c3cf) is waiting for: estimated vs actual cost on 30+ ideas.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Durable realized cost per idea is the data the calibration of cost estimates has been waiting for; refuted if harness cycles turn out too few or too uneven per idea to compare with estimates.

status.comment: Done: each stage records tokens and wall time (trace); harness.json `prices` (USD per million tokens by model id) give each cycle's cost, stored as trace costUsd and shown in the cycle's status event ('Cost unknown' naming unpriced models instead of guessing); `budgets.maxTokensPerCycle` stops before the next stage, `budgets.maxUsdPerDay` skips cycles once today's priced traces reach it. Evidence: costs.test (sum, unpriced, today's spend), cycle.test budgets (priced cost 40 in a mock cycle, token budget stops before verify without status change, daily budget makes no model call and no trace), loop-worker 27/27, backend loop-cycle e2e 3/3, knip clean. Remaining: durable realized cost on the idea — split into the unclear child with the unit question for Felix.
